subject.title: [Docs/Question]: Recommended pattern for telemetry-only message lifecycle capture

question: Should OpenClaw document telemetry-only CRM lifecycle capture as an internal hook pattern, a typed plugin pattern, diagnostics-only guidance, or an external plugin/audit-ledger design?
rationale: The answer would define public guidance around raw message content, WhatsApp identifiers, outbound hook reliability, and local retention/correlation semantics, which automation cannot safely choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Trusted local pattern
options.body: Document internal hooks or a trusted local plugin as the supported pattern, with explicit privacy, retention, idempotency, and per-channel smoke-test caveats.

options.title: Wait for audit primitives
options.body: Keep this open until metadata-only audit and outbound hook parity issues settle, then document one stronger recommended path.

options.title: Route to external plugin docs
options.body: Avoid core CRM guidance and point users toward building a ClawHub/plugin package with only the existing hook-surface caveats documented.

recommendation.title: Trusted local pattern
recommendation.body: Document internal hooks or a trusted local plugin as the supported pattern, with explicit privacy, retention, idempotency, and per-channel smoke-test caveats.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans product guidance, plugin boundary, privacy, and auditability; steipete is the strongest available routing signal from adjacent outbound and audit-design history.
